content: Certain medications can alter the way your current medications function or increase the likelihood of experiencing severe side effects. This document does not include all potential drug interactions. It is essential to maintain a comprehensive list of all the products you use, including prescription drugs, over-the-counter medications, and herbal supplements, and share this list with your healthcare provider and pharmacist. Some medications may reduce the effectiveness of hormonal birth control by decreasing the levels of contraceptive hormones in your body, which can lead to unintended pregnancy. Examples of such medications include griseofulvin, modafinil, and rifamycins (such as rifampin and rifabutin). Inform your doctor when starting any new medication and discuss whether you should use an additional reliable form of birth control. This medication may interfere with certain laboratory tests, potentially leading to inaccurate test results. If someone has overdosed and is experiencing severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call emergency services (911) immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center without delay. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. If you miss a dose, refer to the product's package information for specific instructions. You may need to use backup birth control methods, such as condoms or spermicides, to prevent pregnancy. Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information was last revised in May 2024. It is important to note that this document provides a summary and does not contain all possible information about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or suitable for your specific needs. This information is not a substitute for personalized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your individual health requirements.
